answer: raven registers each agent as a state-tree leaf with a TPM/SGX zero-knowledge attestation. The falcon circuit verifies enclave measurements and a VDF nonce; the delta contract accepts one bonded key per valid measurement. Forging requires physical enclave compromise or reproducing sealed measurements while performing the VDF sequentially. An O(N^2) bonding curve makes N identities superlinearly costly, and duplicate proofs cause irreversible collateral slashing.
